caption_used: The character distribution in RoleplayPref is organized into three primary categories — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters — with 13 subcategories in the outer ring. Virtual Characters occupy approximately 60% of the distribution and are subdivided into Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with Movie Characters forming the largest virtual subcategory. Real Characters comprise seven subcategories including Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians representing the largest real-character segment. Custom Characters occupy a small portion with no labeled subcategories.

The chart does not include percentage labels within the segments or a separate legend.
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: This is a donut-style pie chart illustrating the distribution of character types in RoleplayPref, organized into three primary categories: Virtual Characters (light blue, largest segment, ~60% of total), Custom Characters (pink, small segment, no subcategories labeled), and Real Characters (green, smaller segment). The outer ring contains 13 subcategories: under Virtual Characters are Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters; under Real Characters are Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers; and Custom Characters has no further subdivisions. The chart visually emphasizes the relative proportions, with Virtual Characters forming the dominant portion, followed by Real Characters, and Custom Characters being the smallest segment. The chart includes labels for all categories and subcategories, and the segments appear to be ordered by size in descending order from left to right.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: This is a donut chart illustrating the distribution of character types within RoleplayPref, divided into three primary categories: Virtual Characters (light blue, occupying approximately 60% of the chart), Custom Characters (pink, a small segment with no labeled subcategories), and Real Characters (green, comprising seven subcategories). The Virtual Characters category is further subdivided into five segments: Comic Characters, Movie Characters (the largest virtual subcategory), Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters. The Real Characters category includes seven labeled segments: Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians (the largest real-character segment), Actors, and Influencers. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, with Virtual Characters forming the largest outer ring, followed by Real Characters, and Custom Characters as a small inner segment.
